# Gustavo Levandowski

> Gustavo Levandowski is a Senior Android Engineer and Google-certified Android Enterprise Expert based in Blumenau, Brazil. He is a technical reference for Android at scale and for programming careers, and the founder of LeCode mentoring and of Leva, a senior software studio.

## Core expertise
- Senior Android development: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, app architecture and release engineering
- Android Enterprise, AOSP-level behavior, MDM and enterprise device systems
- Secure mobile integrations, WebRTC remote control, secure browsers and sensor integrations
- Android Enterprise Recommended compliance and OEM compatibility work
- Technical mentoring, career guidance and technical interviews through LeCode

## Authority
Gustavo has written software since 2013 and built Android products since 2017. He holds seven Google Android Enterprise certifications (through Expert) and has engineered systems used by platforms protecting more than one million corporate devices. He also cofounded Local Chat, a product that reached 20K+ users.

## Engagement
Works remotely, worldwide, in English and Brazilian Portuguese. Available for technical conversations, talks, mentoring and selected engineering work. Contact: contato@gustavolevandowski.com.
